goal: Replace count-only export preview with a portable JSON export of this account local data; truthful cloud/local deletion scope and confirmed private sharing.
successCriteria: Private JSON export contains actual saved profile/notes/chat/chart data and explicit local-only scope, excluding auth/device/provider tokens.

Web downloads JSON; native user chosen sheet, private temporary file cleanup after sheet on iOS and bounded 10-minute private-cache retention plus startup cleanup on Android; no claim of user saved/cancel success.
Switching account/read failure stops export; local deletion label never claims cloud account deletion; confirmed journal clear states cloud delete is pending.
untouchedSurfaces: No cloud account deletion, service-role or auth credential changes.
No live DB/migration/deployment or provider call.
All account/global caches and non-export feature data formats preserved.

impact.entryPoint: Profile privacy Export local data -> explicit confirmation -> portable file; truthful clear controls.
impact.dataWrite: Browser JSON or native dedicated app-private export cache. iOS cleanup in finally; Android successful sheet uses 10-minute TTL + next startup cleanup. Failed delivery immediate cleanup.
impact.backendContract: Local device data snapshot only; cloud retention/deletion and complete server export remain unverified R09 gates.
impact.adminVisibility: No export content in Admin/traces. Only export requested/outcome count events.
impact.privacySafety: Read allowlisted data from active account namespace only; no credential/session/devicepush/grant state; redact reserved secret keys in nested snapshots; no automatic destination transmission.
impact.observability: Distinguish download requested/native dialog presented/failed; no misleading cloud export success.
impact.rollback: Remove export UI/driver but preserve source data; retain reviewed old package/lock baseline; native review build must be rebuilt for modules.

canonicalContracts: Existing accountStorage loads, JournalEntry/R07 envelope and astrology.v2/council sessions remain canonical.
Export schema nilaza-local-export-v1 with local-device scope and explicit limitations; no cloud account deletion success.
